name: Counter-Strike: Global Offensive

scale.why: player hull 32 x 32 x 72 u (CS:GO Mapper's Reference), scaled to 1.8 m: 0.025 m/u

speed.source: https://www.vlr.gg/416153/is-valorant-movement-slower-than-cs2 (knife 250 u/s); sv_maxspeed 320 is only the cap (https://csdb.gg/commands/movement/)
speed.note: knife out (community-stated; the game's weapon data, not a cvar)

ground_accel.note: Source accelerate factor (same formula as Quark's); the page's intro also says 5.6

air_accel.note: Quark-equivalent: this engine pushes 12 x the FULL wish speed (250 u/s) per second but caps the gain at 30 u/s; Quark pushes air_accel x 10 x min(wish, air_cap), so the same push is air_accel = 12 x 250 / 30 / 10 (Xonotic's Quake port does the same: sv_airaccelerate 106.67 with sv_maxairspeed 30 for 10 x 320 / 30).

air_cap.note: the air wish-speed cap (Quark's air strafe cap, W-only; A/D raises Quark's x1.1)

overstrafe.source: same code: the push is applied in full whatever its angle to your velocity
overstrafe.note: no overstrafe softening: the whole push against your momentum applies (Quark lets 35% through)

jumpHeight.note: v^2/2g; the Mapper's Reference measures 54-55 u blocks cleared standing, 65-66 crouch-jumping; Quark: 1.22 m

timeTo90.source: derived from this file's speed, ground_accel, friction, stop_speed
timeTo90.note: Quake ground model at 1 ms steps (friction then accelerate), the same way Quark's physsim measures its own run_up / stop presets; Quark: 0.072 s

stopDistance.source: derived from this file's speed, friction, stop_speed
stopDistance.note: Quake ground model at 1 ms steps (friction then accelerate), the same way Quark's physsim measures its own run_up / stop presets; Quark: 1.21 m

stopTime.source: derived from this file's speed, friction, stop_speed
stopTime.note: Quake ground model at 1 ms steps (friction then accelerate), the same way Quark's physsim measures its own run_up / stop presets; Quark: 0.364 s

extras: stamina: each jump costs sv_staminajumpcost 0.08 (sv_stamina_max 80), lowering consecutive jumps (https://csdb.gg/commands/movement/)
bunny hopping speed-capped (sv_enablebunnyhopping 0, no auto-hop: sv_autobunnyhopping 0)
counter-strafing: low accel 5.5 and friction 5.2 make stopping a skill
notes: CS:GO and CS2 share these defaults.

sources.title: Valve Developer Community: CS:GO Mapper's Reference
